stem: Which constitutional guarantee did this act violate?

options.label: J
options.text: The right to a jury trial

visual_elements: That if any person shall write . . . any false, scandalous and malicious . . . writings against the government of the United States, or . . . stir up sedition within the United States . . . then such person . . . shall be punished by a fine not exceeding two thousand dollars, and by imprisonment not exceeding two years.
—An Act of the Fifth Congress of the United States, 1798
